list_models: list all available models from the LiteLLM proxy server in table or JSON format
add_model: add a new model to the LiteLLM proxy with custom parameters and model info
get_models_info: get detailed information about all models including costs, credentials, and timestamps
import_models: import models from a YAML file into the LiteLLM proxy with regex filtering and dry-run support
update_model: update an existing model's configuration with new parameters and model info
